name: Sanjeevani Emergency Medical Ambulance Service (108)
department: Public Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh
beneficiary: Trauma victims, patients in critical condition, pregnant women, and accident victims requiring immediate medical evacuation
benefits: Free 24x7 emergency medical transportation equipped with life-support apparatus, trained emergency medical technicians (EMTs), and direct hospital handover.
eligibility: Anyone experiencing or witnessing a critical medical emergency or severe accident within Madhya Pradesh
application_process: Dial 108 from any mobile phone or landline, state the patient's condition, and share the exact pickup address or nearby landmark.
application_mode: Toll-Free Phone Call / MP 108 Mobile App
